Alex: Heads-up — ran nsys on the repro job and saw kernel-choice flip after driver bump (local 525 -> 531). cuBLAS fast kernels absent, runtime falls back to 'matmul_fallback' heavy loops. Trace qdrep uploaded to drive.
Devon: can you upload the .qdrep? which nsys version did you use?
Alex: attached the qdrep link. nsys 2023.4.1. logs show repeated CUPTI warnings: 'cuptiActivityEnable failed: CUPTI_ERROR_NOT_INITIALIZED' and some permission denied when attaching in a rootless container :eyes:
Maria: interesting — we also saw tail latency increase on small-batch workloads. KV cache hit rate dropped from ~94% to ~68% in the same window. batching heuristic might be evicting prefixes more aggressively.
Devon: two axes to consider: (1) driver changed kernel symbol naming so the runtime's kernel selector falls back, (2) nsys/CUPTI attach in rootless loses activity records — that skews hotspot attribution. can you paste the exact nsys CLI you used?
Alex: ran:
```
nsys profile --output nsys_run1.qdrep --trace=nvtx,cuda,cublas --sample=cpu,cupti -t 60 ./serve_bench.sh
```
Devon: try removing `--sample=cupti` and instead use capture-range and explicit CUPTI capture. also try setting `LD_PRELOAD=/usr/lib/libcupti.so` inside the container. if attach fails, nsys falls back to statistical sampling which will miss a lot of cublas kernels.
Josh: for rootless perms we ended up adding device files and caps in other repos: `--device /dev/nvidiactl --device /dev/nvidia-uvm` plus `--cap-add SYS_ADMIN` so CUPTI can mmap. also check `dmesg` around the driver update for messages.
Maria: repro on a dedicated node confirmed same kernel flip. small perf snippet I collected:
```
cublasSgemm: 1.2s (fast kernel)
matmul_fallback: 4.5s (after update)
kv_cache_lookup: 0.03s per hit, but eviction spikes correlate with bigger slow kernels
```
Devon: can we add a logging flag in the kernel selector to emit chosen kernel symbol + confidence? that'll tell if symbol match failed. also run `strings /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libcublas.so | grep cublasSgemm` to inspect exported names.
Alex: enabled verbose selector — confirmed missing symbol `cublasSgemmEx_v2`, so fast-path didn't trigger.
Maria: noticed batch distribution shifted: more 1–2 token requests after routing change. the batching heuristic uses seq-length histograms; small shift leads to smaller batches -> more kernel invocations -> kv cache thrash.
Devon: mitigations: pin driver on Dedicated until we implement symbol fallback; add a name-mangling heuristic in selector to attempt alternate symbol variants; upgrade nsys to the latest stable (there are CUPTI attach fixes in newer releases).
Josh: ops can pin the driver for the pool — I'll open the infra task. I'll also raise to Nvidia support to check 531 release notes about symbol renames or ABI changes.
Alex: next steps: (1) repeat with LD_PRELOAD to confirm CUPTI record completeness, (2) run a perfetto timeline to measure KV cache evictions vs kernel calls, (3) add selector logging + quick fallback mapping. I'll drop qdrep and trace links in the ticket.
Devon: once we have selector logs, I'll prototype a small patch to try name-mangling heuristics. If CUPTI is flaky in rootless, we should document recommended container flags in docs.
Maria: filing a perf regression ticket with kv cache traces and attaching these logs. :thumbsup:
ci-bot: ticket RF-1023 created: 'driver 531 perf regression — kernel selection & CUPTI attach in rootless' assigned to Devon, Josh, Maria.
